name: Monterey (Cypress Point: cypress, pine, white dunes, Pacific)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json). Cypress Point Club, Pebble Beach CA: deep, saturated coastal turf (greener and cooler than the pnw parkland set, from the developer's aerials), near-white dune sand, deep blue-green Pacific, olive-tan forest floor and dune scrub off the course, grey-brown granite and cypress bark. From the photos in the GitHub release cypress-point-data (2026-10-24). Trees in assets-src/trees_monterey.py: Monterey pine, Monterey cypress and coast live oak. The rocks between the clifftop and the sea (a penalty area, cfg rock_water_osm) use the "rock" keys, with iceplant (F0 red, F1 green) on the ledges. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
